title: Where Cross-Question Structure in LLM Errors Comes From: Shared Seeds, Shared Prompts, and Answer-Letter Preference
abstract: arXiv:2607.20464v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Disagreement between language models is often read as missing knowledge. Questions that need the same missing knowledge should then be right or wrong together. We test for this structure with the eigenvalues of the questions' correlation matrix. Within one model, independently drawn answers show no detectable structure; it appears when all questions in one pass over the benchmark share a random seed or few-shot prompt. Across 24 models, the largest structure beyond overall skill is a preference among answer letters: when the options are rotated, it follows the letter, not the question, and it depends on one model, Llama-3.2-1B; without it only a smaller excess remains. Counting a question correct only if right in every rotation removes the part that acts on guesses. What remains is a marginal excess at the 5% line, tied post hoc to two near-duplicate model pairs and to Llama-3.2-1B.

translated_title: LLM错误中跨问题结构的来源：共享随机种子、共享提示词与答案字母偏好
translated_abstract: 语言模型之间的分歧通常被解读为知识缺失，那么需要同样缺失知识的问题就应当同时答对或答错。我们利用问题相关性矩阵的特征值来检验这种结构。在单个模型内部，独立抽取的答案没有可检测的结构；但当一轮基准测试中的所有问题共享同一随机种子或少样本提示词时，这种结构便会出现。在24个模型中，超越总体能力的最大结构是对答案字母的偏好：当选项被旋转时，它跟随字母而非问题本身，并且这一现象依赖于单一模型Llama-3.2-1B；去掉它之后只剩较小的超额结构。只有当问题在所有选项旋转中都答对才计为正确，可以去除作用于猜测的那部分。剩下的仅在5%显著性水平上存在边际超额，事后可归因于两对近乎重复的模型以及Llama-3.2-1B。
tldr: 该论文通过问题相关性矩阵的特征值分析发现，LLM错误中的跨问题结构主要来自共享随机种子、共享提示词以及对答案字母的偏好（主要由Llama-3.2-1B驱动），而非共享的知识缺失。
en_tdlr: Using eigenvalue analysis of question correlation matrices, this paper shows that cross-question structure in LLM errors stems mainly from shared random seeds, shared prompts, and an answer-letter preference (largely driven by Llama-3.2-1B), rather than shared missing knowledge.
